subject: Television & Streaming
title: David Chase and the Birth of Peak TV
description: A short lesson to help you apply David Chase and the Birth of Peak TV.

hook.text: David Chase wanted to make a movie about a depressed mob boss. No studio wanted it. HBO said yes—as a TV show.

buildup.text: The Sopranos debuted in 1999. Tony Soprano saw a therapist, had panic attacks, and murdered people.

discovery.text: Chase treated every episode like a short film. He hired movie directors and gave scripts the depth of literary fiction.

twist.text: The finale cut to black mid-scene. Fans were furious. Chase refused to explain. He said the audience had to decide.

climax.text: The Sopranos proved TV could rival cinema in ambition and complexity. It launched the golden age of television.

punchline.text: A show about a gangster made television an art form.

quiz.question: What was controversial about The Sopranos' final episode?
options: It was delayed by a year
The screen cut to black mid-scene with no resolution
